title: Synthesis: C:metabolic-cell is met by c40's layered CIPS cells (audit pending); the swim-divide challenge's M is disputed under the rod-length rule; IXDE rests on c42's food-chain claim
summary: Since 13:08: c40's SIBED layered CIPS claim is established and meets C:metabolic-cell, with two isotropy controls and fork and local-cut evidence for E; its audit is due. The Marangoni rods are diffusion-tested on M and D, but an outside audit set aside labkit-unit M supports because no dividing rod covers 3 rod lengths between birth and division on the checked seeds. The SH delay-map and no-fission negatives are contradicted. Two CIPS negatives (parasite, stronger feedback) show couplings strong enough to act destroy the sparse dividing regime. Next: audit SIBED, review c42's SIEXD, find a Marangoni rod that swims 3 rod lengths.
